kind.description: Discriminator selecting the concrete specification variant.

position.title: Position
position.description: Three finite coordinates in the referenced view's local geometry after mesh-baked transforms, before its global transform and layout fit.

color.title: Color
color.description: World annotation text color, also used for the leader when one is drawn.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Optional screen-space pixel offset (dx, dy) from the projected anchor to the panel edge that faces it. +x is right and +y is down. A zero component centers the panel on that axis, so (0, -10) places the label 10 pixels above the anchor. Null keeps automatic placement; it is not the same as (0, 0).

arrow.title: Arrow
arrow.description: Whether to draw an arrow leader connecting the text panel to the 3D anchor. False draws the text alone.

title: FigureSpec

x-hakowan-conventions.attribute_reference: Channel, texture, and transform attribute inputs reference named fields inside the selected geometry source.
x-hakowan-conventions.channel_composition: Each channel key is a semantic slot. Along a root-to-leaf path, the first value for a slot wins; unrelated slots compose.
x-hakowan-conventions.figure: Portable visualization intent serialized as FigureSpec.
x-hakowan-conventions.config: Invocation-time renderer policy; an explicit Config overrides all Figure-derived rendering configuration.
x-hakowan-conventions.scalar_field: To color geometry by a scalar attribute, use a diffuse material whose reflectance is a scalar_field texture. Supply only data.name for the default inferred domain, viridis colormap, and automatic legend.
